items.title: Welspun Living zooms 112% in 6 months, hits new high; what's driving stock?
items.description: With 87% of revenue derived from bed and bath linen, which are eligible for RoSCTL benefits of 8.2% of export value, Welspun is a key beneficiary of the scheme, said analysts at Jefferies.

items.title: MTNL zooms 17% on board nod to Mumbai property sale worth ₹891.53 cr

items.title: India's domestic funds push IPO valuations lower amid market strain
items.description: The median price-to-book ratio for IPOs raising at least ₹1,000 crore fell to 7.4 times in 2026 from 10.2 times last year as local funds push for lower valuations

items.title: Hero Motors hits new high; stock up 99% against issue price in 7 days
items.description: Hero Motors' share price hit a new high of ₹167.45 in Thursday's intraday trade. The stock has more than doubled, up 108% from its listing day's low of ₹80.50 on the BSE.

items.title: Adani Energy Solutions gains 5.5%; extends winning streak to 3rd session
